cards.claim: Large batch sizes require specially designed learning rate schedules to achieve comparable performance to smaller batch training
cards.conditions: Large-batch training in deep learning contexts
cards.effect: Without specially designed LR schedules, large batch training degrades performance relative to small-batch training
cards.evidence: Direct statement from abstract; general principle in large-batch training
cards.quote: While it is computationally beneficial to use large batch sizes, it often requires a specially designed learning rate (LR) schedule to achieve a comparable level of performance as in smaller batch training.

cards.claim: Under fixed epoch budgets, large learning rate and warmup strategy are critical for large-batch training due to reduced number of updating steps
cards.conditions: Constrained number of training epochs, large batch size
cards.effect: LR and warmup strategy criticality increases when steps per epoch decrease; final performance depends heavily on these choices
cards.evidence: Direct statement of relationship between epoch constraint and step count impact
cards.quote: Especially, when the number of training epochs is constrained, the use of a large LR and a warmup strategy is critical in the final performance of large-batch training due to the reduced number of updating steps.

cards.claim: LR adjustment via scheduler can maintain comparable or better performance across diverse batch sizes without extensive hyperparameter tuning
cards.conditions: Various image classification benchmarks and architectures, wide range of batch sizes
cards.effect: Comparable or better performance than tuned baselines when using automated LR scheduling
cards.evidence: Experimental results across multiple benchmarks and architectures
cards.quote: the proposed scheduler successfully adjusts the LRs without cumbersome hyperparameter tuning and achieves comparable or better performances than tuned baselines on various image classification benchmarks and architectures with a wide range of batch sizes.
